notes: TWO folded thicknesses are published, split by back-cover variant (not hinge/non-hinge side): PU Version folded 9.9 mm / unfolded 4.7 mm @ approx. 231 g, and Glass Version folded 10.1 mm / unfolded 4.8 mm @ approx. 237 g. Per the larger-value rule the Glass Version figures are recorded in closed.depth (10.1), open.depth (4.8) and mass_g (237) so the entry stays internally consistent with one real configuration; the PU figures are the ones HONOR markets. No hinge-side vs non-hinge-side thickness is published, so depth_at_hinge is null. Height 156.7 mm is published as a single value (HONOR does not split it by state), so it is repeated for closed and open. HONOR's China page states the dimensions exclude the screen protective films and the camera bump: "整机尺寸不包含内外屏保护膜的厚度以及摄像头凸起部分" ("overall dimensions do not include the thickness of the inner/outer screen protective films or the camera bump") - https://www.honor.com/cn/phones/honor-magic-v2/. resolution_px is recorded in HONOR's own printed order (long axis first). active_area_mm left null: HONOR states the diagonals are standard-rectangle measurements and "the actual viewable area is slightly smaller", so any derivation would misstate the real active area. crease: the global page's "suspended water-drop support" (China page: "悬浮式水滴支撑") is the OEM's own water-drop/teardrop claim. materials.frame null - no frame material is stated on any HONOR page for this model. materials.cover_glass: the page says "Second-generation Nanocrystal Glass" without naming which screen it covers. released null - the China press release gives only a pre-order date ("Starting from 12 July, the HONOR Magic V2 can be pre-ordered in China"), not an on-sale date; the global on-sale date was not found on a manufacturer page. || EVIDENCE SWEEP 2026-09-13: these values were present in the research pass but carried NO sources[] entry covering their field, so they were set to null per the registry rule (a value without a citation is an assertion, not evidence). Preserved verbatim here so a human can re-source rather than re-research: hinge.type = 'book'; hinge.axis = 'long'.
